Character Direction Guide

Direction determines which way your character faces during the animation. This is crucial for isometric games where characters need to face different directions as they move around the game world.

Perfect for Isometric Games

  • • Characters can face all 8 directions (cardinal + diagonal)
  • • Essential for RPGs, strategy games, and top-down adventures
  • • Auto-repose will adjust your character to face the selected direction
  • • Each direction creates a unique animation optimized for that facing

How It Works

  • • Select the direction your character should face during the action
  • • Our AI generates animations where the character faces that direction
  • • Perfect for movement, combat, and interaction animations
  • • Works with all available actions (walk, attack, cast, etc.)

Sample Starting Pose

This is the ideal starting pose. Make your starting pose as close as possible to this to ensure the best animation quality. For weapon animations, please make sure add the weapon to the exactly same hand as shown in the demo animation.
